approveBlocked: Approve is not available until the missing details are complete.
nothingMore: Nothing more to do. The full record stays on this page.

detail.notSentYet: Not sent by the admin team yet

pending.notRecorded: Not recorded yet. Use Record Outcome above.
pending.waitingDetails: Waiting for the missing details. {{details}}. Use Complete Missing Details above.
pending.reviewStarted: Review started. Use Continue Review above to approve, decline or ask for information.
pending.waitingReview: Waiting for your review. Use Start Review above. Opening this page doesn't start it.
pending.ownerNeedsMore: The owner needs more information. Update the facts if needed, then use Send to Owner above.
pending.notSent: Not sent yet. Use Send to Owner above.
pending.sent: Sent. Waiting for the owner's decision.

whatNext.ready: This is inside the rules. Do it in your own systems, then record what you did here. Tutor Compass doesn't move money or change bookings.
whatNext.approved: The owner approved this request. Do it in your own systems, then record what you did here.
whatNext.declined: The owner declined this request. Let the family know, then record what you did here.
whatNext.details: {{details}} before a decision can be made. Add them with Complete Missing Details and the rules will check the request again.
whatNext.detailsOwner: {{details}} before a decision can be made. Add them with Complete Missing Details and the rules will check the request again. You can still start a review, but you can't approve it yet.
whatNext.continue: Continue your review and record your decision. The admin team then records what was done.
whatNext.continueSensitive: Continue your review and record your decision. You can also add handling notes and next steps as you go. The admin team then records what was done.
whatNext.start: Start the review when you're ready. Starting it records that you're handling this. It doesn't approve, close or change anything else.
whatNext.ownerNeedsMore: The owner needs more information. Update the facts if needed, then send it back to the owner.
whatNext.send: Send this to the owner. Once the owner decides, you record the outcome here. That is the last step.
whatNext.ownerLooking: The owner is looking at this. You'll see their decision here, then you record the outcome.
whatNext.detailsBefore: {{details}}. Add them before a decision is made.
